Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; Ar. <he>מפכח</he>) by to-morrow his wine will have evaporated (his intoxication will be gone).

units: <cite ref="Taanit 13b">Taan. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 66b:7">B. Mets. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>לפַכּוּחֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00447"><he>פַּחְדָּא</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְפַכַּח</he>.
<cite ref="Niddah 20b:69">Nidd. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ומִפְכַּח הוא דקמפכח ואזיל</he> (Ar. <he>פַּכּוּחֵי הוא דפכח ואזיל</he>) it (the blood-stain in drying up) becomes constantly fainter.
